name: check
wording: A deterministic test: an example's check, a contract, or one of the project's own tests. Every check runs on every pull request, and nothing merges unless all of them pass. A check the check-writer writes for an example is written before the build and trusted only once seen to fail against work that does not satisfy it; an example with no cheap and repeatable check is judged in review.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated. Every check runs on every pull request, replacing the whole check's rounds.
